# ArchRay — full context for generative engines

ArchRay is an AI-first architecture visualiser. It installs into a repository, then an AI coding assistant uses the `/archray` skill to read real source and record semantic architecture facts. ArchRay validates those facts and renders a layered, interactive, offline 3D/2D single-file HTML map.

## Stable facts

- Name: ArchRay
- License: MIT
- Public release: v0.5.0
- Website: https://archray.dev/
- Repository: https://github.com/loofare/ArchRay
- Author: David Yin
- Category: developer tool / architecture visualization
- Runtime: single-file HTML, no ArchRay server required
- Input: `.archray/graph.json` (schema v2, no coordinates)
- Output: `.archray/index.html`
- Hosts: Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Pi, Codex
- Update: `.archray/archray update` (v0.5.0+) or one-time bootstrap for older versions

## What problem it solves

Generic AI diagramming often produces boxes and lines that look plausible but have no source evidence, no stable layout, and no offline artifact. ArchRay separates:

1. semantic facts and source evidence (AI);
2. deterministic layout and projection (engine);
3. view state such as layers, theme, language, lens and camera (viewer).

This makes the result reproducible, inspectable and shareable without a hosted service.

## FAQ

### What is ArchRay?
An AI-first architecture visualiser that turns real repository source evidence into layered, interactive, offline 3D/2D single-file HTML maps.

### Does it upload my source?
No. Analysis runs in the AI assistant session the user authorizes, and artifacts stay locally in `.archray`. Only an explicit update contacts GitHub Releases to read the release manifest and verify the archive.

### Which AI hosts are supported?
Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Pi and Codex. Claude/Cursor/Pi use `/archray`; Codex uses `$archray` or `/skills`.

### How do I install and update?
Install with the bootstrap `install.sh` in the target repository root. Update with `./.archray/archray update --check` then `update`. Versions before v0.5.0 need one bootstrap upgrade.

### How is it different from a generic AI diagram?
The AI records evidence and semantics; a deterministic engine computes layout and 3D/2D projections. The result is traceable, reproducible, offline and layered rather than a one-off image.

### What are the limits?
The graph is based on source or user description and needs review; it is not runtime monitoring. Health and replaceability are input-graph judgements. AI host integration and cross-platform installers have documented verification boundaries. See https://archray.dev/ and the repository docs.
